module: Auxiliary controller that computes the brake light value (`electrics.values.brakelights` by default) beyond the simple brake pedal: blinking during ABS, turning on during an ESC intervention above 14 m/s, turning on when deceleration ("one pedal" regeneration) exceeds a threshold, adding regenerative braking, and automatically turning on the hazard lights after emergency braking until stop. Call order: `defaultOrder = 900` (late).
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `electricsName` ("brakelights"), `indicateESCUsageWithBrakelights` (true), `activateHazardsAfterEmergencyBraking` (true), `hazardArmSpeed` (10 m/s), `hazardActivateSpeed` (3 m/s), `hazardDeactivateThrottle` (0.3), `hazardDeactivateSpeed` (3 m/s), `blinkOnTime` (0.1 s), `blinkOffTime` (0.1 s), `activateBrakeLightsFromDecel` (true), `decelThreshold` (1.3 m/s², UK legal threshold according to the comment).

Electrics read: brake, absActive, escActive, isYCBrakeActive (takes priority over escActive if it exists), wheelspeed, throttle, regenFromOnePedal, regenFromBrake. Electrics written: the value of `electricsName`, rounded up (0 or 1).
The jbeam field has no safe access: updateGFX uses `electrics.values.wheelspeed` and `electrics.values.brake` without a default value in some computations; they must exist.
The hazard lights are activated by `electrics.set_warn_signal(true)`, deactivated when the throttle exceeds the threshold at sufficient speed.

defaultOrder.desc: 900: default call rank, late in the sorted list.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: computes the brake light value (brake + ESC + deceleration + regeneration, clamped to 1), applies the ABS blinking and handles the emergency braking hazard lights.

reset.desc: Turns off the hazard lights triggered by this controller and resets the timers, smoothers and latches.

init.desc: Reads the jbeam parameters and creates the smoothers (ABS, ESC, acceleration).

setParameters.desc: Enables or disables the adaptive behavior; when disabled, the lights simply follow the brake.
